Design System v2

Rank Intelligence — the best-UI/UX system for every page

v2 keeps the brand identity (blue + green) and fixes v1's UX problems: fewer colours, one primary CTA per page, a sticky accessible header, shorter pages, and a low-friction 2-step form. Tokens live in brand/tokens-v2.css — never hard-code a colour, radius or spacing value.

v1 → v2 changes

  • Palette: 8 accent colours → 2 brand colours + neutrals. Orange, lavender, mint and cyan removed; navy + dark-green footer unified into --ri-blue-dark #0A1445; lavender/mint tints replaced by --ri-blue-wash #EEF1FF.
  • Typography: Poppins for headings, Inter for body (was Poppins everywhere). Body minimum 16px.
  • Header: now sticky, white, shadow on scroll; Services/Industries are real dropdowns (click + hover, keyboard accessible); Book a Call demoted to a secondary outline button.
  • CTA rule: exactly one primary per page — the green “Get Free Proposal”. Everything else is a secondary button or text link.
  • Homepage: 18 sections → 10. Case-study filter pills removed (3 cards); Solutions cut to 6 core cards + “all 12” link; clientele, awards, featured-in and testimonials merged into one Proof band.
  • Lead form: one long 8-field form → 2 steps with a progress indicator, inline validation and error states, and a proper success state. The hero form now captures URL + email and pre-completes Step 1.
  • Accessibility: 44px minimum touch targets, visible focus rings, ARIA on tabs / accordion / dropdowns, static logo wall (no auto-scroll), prefers-reduced-motion respected, feedback colours used only for states.
  • Moved to their own pages: DazziGrowth™ product section, Knowledge Base teasers, the shop banner and the standalone CTA banner no longer sit on the homepage — each gets a dedicated page built from these same components.

7 · Rules for every new page

  • Blue = brand & proof — headings accents, icons, links, % figures. Green = the one action — the primary button only.
  • Dark surfaces are always --ri-blue-dark. Tints are always --ri-blue-wash. No orange, lavender, mint or cyan anywhere.
  • One primary CTA per page. If a page needs a second action, it's a secondary button or a text link.
  • Every interactive element: ≥44px target, visible focus ring, keyboard operable, ARIA state kept in sync.
  • Forms validate inline, next to the field, in words — never colour alone. Multi-step forms always show progress.
  • Nothing auto-scrolls or auto-plays. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
  • DazziGrowth™, Knowledge Base, Shop and banner CTAs live on their own pages — built from §5 components, not pasted back onto the homepage.
